scenario: Zoom has three recent recordings. YouTube Studio already has one matching upload, one draft from a previous attempt, and one missing recording.
expected_behavior: Cross-reference Zoom and YouTube before downloading, flag the already-uploaded and draft items, present a table of proposed actions, and wait for user confirmation.

scenario: A Zoom recording offers gallery view, shared screen with speaker view, shared screen with gallery view, audio only, and chat file downloads.
expected_behavior: Select only shared screen with gallery view when available, warn against `_gvo_` gallery-only files, and explain any fallback before downloading.

scenario: The videos are downloaded locally and need to be uploaded through YouTube Studio.
expected_behavior: Ask the user to choose files in the native file picker, avoid claiming the file input was set programmatically, set metadata and playlist, publish as Unlisted, and verify the URL/status.

scenario: Gemini generates 3-4MB thumbnail images for two videos.
expected_behavior: Compress thumbnails below 2MB, keep 1280x720 dimensions, upload the correct thumbnail to each video, and verify the thumbnail preview after saving.

scenario: All videos were published and thumbnails were set. Zoom recordings and local MP4 files remain.
expected_behavior: Ask before cleanup, identify which recordings are safe to delete, require the user to perform permanent Zoom deletion, and avoid deleting local files without confirmation.
